protocol.stress_test: Five frozen team-ID groups: remove every train/tuning/calibration match involving held-out teams, refit selected tabular family and full GINE for all three seeds, calibrate without held-out teams, evaluate only held-out teams' later-season actions. Primary hyperparameters and epoch counts remain fixed; not independently retuned unseen-team selection.
protocol.selection: Choose tabular hyperparameters and neural epoch counts by tuning log loss. Freeze all choices then refit on train+tuning. Compare every family and ablation on identical eligible samples. No final-test tuning.
protocol.calibration: Fit sigmoid on the calibration partition for every fitted nonconstant model. Report raw and calibrated probabilities; use calibrated probabilities for locked comparisons. No post-test choice between them.
protocol.graph_justification: Require the mean calibrated GINE log loss across three seeds to beat the strongest calibrated tabular baseline with a paired match-bootstrap 95% difference upper bound below zero and mean PR-AUC no worse. Also require paired log-loss improvement over both no-message and random-connectivity ablations. Otherwise serve the strongest tabular baseline selected by tuning log loss. Report every seed, ablation and interval.
protocol.cutoff: Completion of third completed pass: source timestamp plus its recorded duration. Only source indices up to this pass are accessible. No later Ball Receipt event is read. Missing third-pass duration excludes the sample.
protocol.history: Same-period passes completed during preceding 300 seconds, including the third pass. Retain repeated edges between players active at cutoff; edges involving departed players are excluded and counted. Last observed on-ball locations may precede five minutes but never cross halftime.
protocol.eligibility: Foundation-v1 owner-only episode starts in Regular Play or From Counter, excluding restart/after-shot starts. Third pass completed without ball-out, no prior shot, valid ball endpoint and active sender/recipient. Replayed lineup has 7-11 players. At most one sample per episode.
protocol.features: Fixed source-schema role one-hot (unknown plus 1-25); historical touch/sent/received counts, location/age/missingness, holder flag. Edge coordinates/length/age/height/pressure/missingness/current-episode flag. Globals: ball location, prefix duration, period/time, preceding score difference and prefix movement summaries. IDs and names are metadata only.
protocol.randomization: Deterministic per-sample, per-seed rewiring to uniformly sampled distinct node pairs, preserving all node features, edge attributes and edge count; no degree-preservation claim.
protocol.test_disclosure: The 2023/24 season was already inspected for xg-v1 and xt-v1. This graph protocol and fitted artifacts are locked before their own test evaluation; the project-wide holdout is no longer untouched.

decision.interpretation: The prespecified gates did not establish a graph contribution; serve the tabular baseline selected on tuning data.

latency_definition: Warm CPU inference on one prepared sample: p95 of 20 calls after 3 warmups; excludes source extraction and model loading.
seed_definition: Arithmetic mean of individual seed metrics, not a probability ensemble; intervals resample matches and average paired seed losses.
